name: Heavy Grinding Stone
label: Quest
description: Heavy Grinding Stone: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: To help with my workout, I like to fit a staff between heavy grinding stones, then lift the staff over my head. It isn't easy, but being the strongest woman in the world, like I am, can't be earned sitting down!
Can you help me? I need more grinding stones - bring me some and I'll trade Darkmoon Faire tickets for them.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You brought the stones! And they're heavy! I can already feel my muscles getting bigger. Thanks friend!
Here, take these tickets, and be sure not to eat too many sweets while you're at the faire. A big strong adventurer like you needs to keep themselves in fighting shape!
